answer.original_source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVIDIA Blog, 2026-07-01, party statement; the Sharon AI and Firmus quotes and the DSX campus figures are relayed from the same release)
answer.new_information: NVIDIA says a new business model lets AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers via a revenue-sharing and credit-support model, with NVIDIA earning standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity. The release gives no dollar amounts, no credit-support size or terms, no revenue-share percentage, no timing and no period. Named partners are Sharon AI and Firmus (Batam campus: up to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs, stated as expected, no date). No stored question or piece covers this model, so nothing is updated and nothing is confirmed by an independent source.
answer.new_question: Does NVIDIA's revenue-sharing and credit-support model with AI clouds create financing exposure (credit support, circular demand) and a recurring usage-linked revenue stream that is material to NVDA's product-revenue outlook?
answer.independent_judgement: The record is a material change in how NVIDIA monetises demand: beyond selling hardware, it takes a share of cloud revenue and provides credit support to customers of AI clouds. That adds a potential balance-sheet and counterparty-credit exposure and a circularity link between NVIDIA's own funding of demand and its reported revenue. The benefit (recurring, usage-linked earnings and faster adoption) is asserted by NVIDIA with no sizing. The investment view to track is that the economics are unquantified and self-described, so exposure should be assessed once the filing discloses credit-support commitments, revenue-share terms, and any recognition of cloud-linked revenue.
answer.reason: Catalog and stored pieces are empty, so there is no existing question to update. The record carries an investment judgement (new revenue-share and credit-support exposure that could change the position) that no question covers, and the view can be stated. It is a vendor-only, unquantified announcement, so it is proposed as a new question rather than treated as a settled number.
